title: 経営コンサルタント

title: 行政書士

title: 土地家屋調査士

AI could automate aspects of document analysis and digital form preparation, impacting the role significantly.

title: 翻訳者
outlook_desc: Stable demand, some automation impact (需要は安定、自動化の影響あり)
exposure_rationale: Translation is primarily a digital task involving language processing, an area where AI is rapidly advancing. While nuances and cultural context require human oversight, AI can handle a significant portion of the workload, especially in technical and standardized documents. This will lead to significant changes in how translators work, even if it doesn't eliminate the need for human translators entirely.

title: 通訳者
outlook_desc: Slight growth due to tourism and globalization. (観光とグローバル化で緩やかな成長)
exposure_rationale: Translation is a task AI is rapidly improving at. The need for human interpreters will likely shift towards higher-level, culturally sensitive, and complex situations.

title: 弁護士

exposure_rationale: While client interaction and courtroom advocacy require uniquely human skills, AI can significantly assist with legal research, document review, and drafting legal documents. This will reshape the role, automating many tasks but not replacing the core judgment and client relationship aspects, especially given the complexity of Japanese law and cultural nuances in dispute resolution.

title: 公認会計士
outlook_desc: Slight growth due to complex regulations (緩やかな成長)
exposure_rationale: While auditing involves some on-site work and judgment, a significant portion involves analyzing financial data and records, tasks AI can automate and enhance. AI can assist with fraud detection, risk assessment, and compliance checks, reshaping the role of the 公認会計士 to focus on higher-level analysis and interpretation.

title: 弁理士

While human judgment and client interaction remain crucial, AI can automate many aspects of patent application drafting and prior art searching, increasing efficiency and potentially reshaping the role.

title: 税理士

exposure_rationale: Tax accountants perform primarily knowledge-based work involving tax law, calculations, and form preparation, all of which can be significantly augmented or partially automated by AI. While client interaction and judgment remain important, AI can handle much of the routine analysis and compliance tasks, reshaping the profession.

title: 不動産鑑定士

The human element of negotiation and understanding local market dynamics will remain important, but the core analytical work will be heavily influenced by AI.

title: 気象予報士

The human role will likely shift towards interpreting AI outputs and communicating forecasts effectively.

title: ビル施設管理

title: 駐車場管理

title: ビル清掃

The need for physical presence and manipulation of tools in varied environments limits AI's impact significantly.

title: 鉄道車両清掃

The emphasis on traditional techniques and real-time adjustments makes full automation unlikely, especially considering the cultural importance of the chef's personal touch in Japanese cuisine.

The real-time interaction with customers also limits AI's role.

title: そば・うどん調理人

title: 観光バスガイド

exposure_rationale: A 総務課長 (General Affairs Manager) involves managing and supervising tasks like document management, legal compliance, internal/external communications, and asset management. While some aspects require human judgment and interaction, many tasks can be augmented or automated by AI, especially in document processing, compliance monitoring, and data analysis for asset management. The role will likely shift towards overseeing AI-driven systems and handling exceptions.

title: 人事課長
outlook_desc: Stable demand, replacement needs due retirements. 横ばい
exposure_rationale: While managing a team and navigating complex interpersonal dynamics requires human skills, many of the tasks under the人事課長's purview, such as recruitment, payroll processing, and benefits administration, can be significantly augmented or even automated by AI. AI can also assist with data-driven decision-making in areas like talent acquisition and performance management, freeing up the 人事課長 to focus on strategic initiatives and employee relations.

title: 経理課長
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to automation/efficiency (自動化で微減)
exposure_rationale: 経理課長's responsibilities, such as managing accounting tasks, creating financial statements, and preparing tax documents, are highly susceptible to automation by AI. While leadership and oversight remain important, AI can significantly streamline and improve the efficiency of these core functions, impacting the role's daily tasks and required skill set.

title: 営業課長
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to efficiency gains (効率化).
exposure_rationale: While sales managers require human interaction and strategic thinking, AI can significantly assist with data analysis, sales forecasting, and customer relationship management. AI can automate routine tasks and provide insights to improve sales performance, but the human element of leadership and negotiation remains crucial.

title: デバッグ作業
outlook_desc: Slight growth due to digital transformation (デジタル化).
exposure_rationale: Debugging involves analyzing code, identifying errors, and suggesting fixes, all tasks where AI is rapidly improving. While some debugging requires creative problem-solving, much of it can be automated with AI tools that analyze code and identify potential issues, significantly reshaping the role.

title: ナレーター
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to automation and competition (競争激化)
exposure_rationale: While voice acting involves artistry and nuance, AI voice synthesis is rapidly improving. AI can already generate narrations for informational content, impacting the demand for human narrators, especially in areas like automated announcements and simple explanations. The human element of emotion and artistic interpretation will remain valuable, but AI will likely handle a significant portion of narration tasks.

title: 出荷・受荷事務
outlook_desc: Automation and efficiency improvements cause slight decline. (自動化で微減)
exposure_rationale: This occupation involves significant data entry, record keeping, and inventory management, all of which can be automated or augmented by AI. While some physical verification is involved, the core tasks are information processing and coordination, making it highly susceptible to AI influence.

title: 郵便局郵便窓口業務
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to digitization (デジタル化で若干減少)
exposure_rationale: This role involves significant data entry, processing transactions, and providing information, all of which AI can automate or augment. While some customer interaction exists, AI-powered chatbots and automated systems can handle many routine inquiries and tasks, increasing efficiency and potentially reducing the need for human workers in this role.

title: マーチャンダイザー、バイヤー
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to retail shifts (小売の変化でわずかに減少)
exposure_rationale: Merchandising and buying involve significant data analysis (sales trends, customer preferences) and digital communication with suppliers. While some aspects like product development require human creativity, AI can automate much of the data-driven decision-making and trend forecasting, impacting the role significantly.

title: 歯科助手
outlook_desc: Slight growth due to dental care demand. (需要はわずかに増加)
exposure_rationale: Dental assistants involve a mix of physical tasks (preparing instruments, assisting with procedures) and administrative duties (reception, scheduling). While AI can automate some administrative tasks and potentially assist with diagnostics, the hands-on assistance during dental procedures and patient interaction require human presence and dexterity, limiting full automation.

title: 保育補助者
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to declining birthrate (少子化で若干減少)
exposure_rationale: While some administrative tasks could be automated, the core responsibilities involve direct physical interaction with children, requiring empathy, real-time judgment, and physical care. These aspects are difficult for AI to replicate effectively, especially considering the need for nuanced responses to individual children's needs.

title: 造船技能者（造船工、船舶艤装工等）
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to automation, overseas competition
exposure_rationale: This occupation involves significant physical manipulation of materials and welding, which are difficult for AI to automate fully in the near future. While AI could assist with design and optimization, the core tasks require manual dexterity and real-time adjustments in a physical environment.

title: 検査工（食料品等）
outlook_desc: Automation and consolidation cause slight decline (小幅減少)
exposure_rationale: While the job involves physical inspection, AI-powered visual inspection systems and sensor technologies can automate many aspects of quality control, especially for consistency in appearance, fill levels, and detection of foreign objects. The diversity of food types and potential for nuanced defects still requires some human oversight, but AI can handle a significant portion of the routine tasks.

title: クレーン運転士
outlook_desc: Strong construction demand offsets automation (建設需要が強い)
exposure_rationale: Operating a crane involves physical manipulation and spatial awareness in a dynamic environment. While AI could assist with route planning and safety monitoring, the actual operation requires real-time judgment and physical dexterity that is difficult to automate fully, especially considering the variability of loads and environments.

title: 造船技術者（船舶の開発・設計）
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to automation, global competition (競争激化)
exposure_rationale: Ship design involves significant computer-aided design (CAD) and simulation work, areas where AI can enhance efficiency. While client interaction and specification negotiation require human skills, the core design and production information creation are susceptible to AI augmentation and automation.

title: バイオマス発電プラントの設計
outlook_desc: バイオマス発電設計: 需要は増加傾向にある
exposure_rationale: Designing a biomass power plant involves significant digital work, including creating blueprints and simulations. While some on-site adjustments are needed, the core design process can be heavily augmented by AI tools for optimization and efficiency, placing it in the high exposure category.

title: UX/UIデザイナー
outlook_desc: デジタル化で需要が急増 (kyūzō)
exposure_rationale: UX/UI design involves significant digital work, including wireframing, prototyping, and visual design, all areas where AI tools are rapidly improving. While creativity and user empathy remain important, AI can automate many repetitive tasks and generate design options, significantly impacting the role.

title: アニメ制作進行管理
outlook_desc: アニメ業界は成長、制作進行管理の需要増
exposure_rationale: While the role involves coordination and communication, much of the scheduling and progress tracking can be augmented by AI. Budget management and some communication tasks could also be streamlined, but the need for human interaction and nuanced judgment regarding creative workflows keeps the score from being higher.

title: プロスポーツ運営団体職員（企画・運営）
outlook_desc: Slight growth due to regional sports expansion. (地方スポーツ拡大でわずかな成長)
exposure_rationale: This role involves a mix of marketing, sales, and event planning, all of which can be augmented by AI. AI can assist with data analysis for ticket sales, targeted marketing campaigns, and fan engagement strategies. However, the human element of building relationships with sponsors and managing the live event experience provides a barrier to full automation.

title: 訪問介護のサービス提供責任者
outlook_desc: 高齢化で需要が急増 (Rapid demand increase due to aging)
exposure_rationale: While the role involves creating care plans and managing service delivery, it also requires significant human interaction, assessment of individual needs, and coordination with various stakeholders. AI could assist with data analysis and plan generation, but the nuanced judgment and interpersonal skills are difficult to automate completely, especially given Japan's emphasis on personalized care.

title: 障害者グループホーム世話人
outlook_desc: 大きな需要増、深刻な人手不足
exposure_rationale: This role involves significant hands-on care and real-time human interaction, which are difficult for AI to replicate. While some administrative tasks might be aided by AI, the core responsibilities require empathy and physical presence, limiting AI's impact.

title: 汎用金属工作機械工（旋盤工、ボール盤工等）
outlook_desc: NC機械化で需要減、熟練工は必要 (Decreasing demand due to NC automation, skilled workers still needed)
exposure_rationale: This occupation involves primarily physical manipulation of metal using machinery. While CNC machines are prevalent, the description emphasizes the hands-on nature of operating universal machine tools, requiring manual adjustments and skilled judgment. AI could assist with process optimization but cannot fully replace the physical dexterity and real-time decision-making required.

title: 自動車板金塗装
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to automation and aging.
exposure_rationale: Automobile body repair and painting involves significant physical manipulation and hands-on work. While AI could assist with color matching or damage assessment, the actual repair and painting require dexterity and judgment that are difficult to automate fully. The physical nature of the work limits AI's impact to assistance rather than replacement.

title: 配電盤・制御盤等組立
outlook_desc: Automation and efficiency gains cause slight decline. 減少傾向
exposure_rationale: This occupation involves physical assembly and wiring, which are difficult for current AI to automate fully. However, AI could assist with design optimization, quality control through image recognition, and predictive maintenance of the assembled panels, leading to a moderate exposure score.

title: 社会学研究者
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to university restructuring (大学再編のため小幅減少)
exposure_rationale: While fieldwork and nuanced interpretation of social phenomena require human judgment, AI can significantly assist in data analysis, literature reviews, and identifying patterns in large datasets. AI could also automate some aspects of research proposal writing and report generation, reshaping the research process itself.

title: 鉄道車両の設計・開発
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to automation, population decline
exposure_rationale: Railway vehicle design and development involves significant digital work, including CAD and simulation software. AI can assist in optimizing designs, analyzing performance data, and automating aspects of the detailed design phase, impacting the work of design engineers. However, the need for human oversight and judgment in ensuring safety and regulatory compliance limits full automation.

title: 探偵
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to technology adoption. (技術導入で若干減少)
exposure_rationale: While AI can assist with data analysis, facial recognition, and online investigations, the core of a detective's work relies on physical surveillance, interviewing, and real-time judgment in unpredictable situations. The human element of building trust and interpreting nuanced social cues is difficult for AI to replicate, especially in Japan's cultural context.

title: 麻酔科医
outlook_desc: 高齢化で麻酔科医の需要が増加
exposure_rationale: Anesthesiologists require significant medical knowledge and decision-making skills, which AI can assist with through data analysis and predictive modeling. However, the real-time judgment, physical intervention (intubation, drug administration), and patient interaction aspects of the job create a barrier to full automation, but AI can still significantly reshape the role by optimizing drug dosages and monitoring patient vitals.

title: 検疫官（看護師）
outlook_desc: 感染症対策需要増加で、需要は増加傾向
exposure_rationale: While some aspects like data collection and reporting can be aided by AI, the core responsibilities of a quarantine nurse, such as assessing individuals for symptoms, administering vaccinations, and providing immediate care, require human judgment and physical presence. The need for empathy and real-time decision-making in unpredictable situations limits full automation.

title: 養護教諭
outlook_desc: Slight growth due to student health needs. (わずかな増加、健康ニーズのため)
exposure_rationale: While AI could assist with record-keeping, scheduling appointments, and providing basic health information, the core responsibilities of a 養護教諭 involve hands-on care, emotional support, and real-time judgment in assessing student health needs. The human element and physical presence are crucial, limiting AI's impact to moderate levels.

title: イベントの企画・運営
outlook_desc: Slight growth due to tourism and events (観光とイベントで緩やかな成長)
exposure_rationale: Event planning involves significant digital communication, data analysis for target audiences, and project management, all areas where AI can assist. However, the need for real-time problem-solving, negotiation with stakeholders, and on-site management creates a barrier to full automation, limiting AI's impact to augmentation.

title: 学校事務（私立大学）
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to university consolidation
exposure_rationale: School administration in a private university involves a mix of digital tasks (student records, data entry, communication) and human interaction (student support, faculty coordination). AI can automate many administrative tasks and data analysis, but the human element of student support and nuanced communication will remain important, albeit reshaped by AI tools.

title: 児童発達支援管理責任者
outlook_desc: 急成長：障害児支援ニーズ増大、深刻な人手不足
exposure_rationale: This role involves significant direct interaction with children with disabilities and their families, requiring empathy, nuanced judgment, and adaptability in real-time. While AI could assist with administrative tasks and data analysis related to service plans, the core responsibilities of building rapport, providing emotional support, and making complex decisions based on individual needs are difficult to automate effectively. Therefore, the AI exposure is moderate.

title: 納棺師
outlook_desc: 高齢化で需要増加、人手不足 (Aging society, labor shortage)
exposure_rationale: 納棺師's work involves significant physical handling of the deceased, requiring dexterity and sensitivity that AI cannot replicate. While some administrative tasks might be aided by AI, the core function is inherently physical and emotionally nuanced, limiting AI's impact.

title: 耐震診断
outlook_desc: Strong demand due to aging infrastructure (需要増)
exposure_rationale: While physical inspection is involved, a significant portion of耐震診断 involves analyzing structural data, running simulations, and generating reports, all of which can be augmented or partially automated by AI. AI can assist in identifying vulnerabilities and suggesting reinforcement plans, though human oversight remains crucial for complex cases and final judgment.

title: 作業環境測定士
outlook_desc: Slight growth due to health regulations (緩やかな成長)
exposure_rationale: While the occupation involves physical measurement and on-site assessment, the core tasks of data analysis, report generation, and suggesting improvements based on regulations can be significantly augmented by AI. AI can automate data processing, identify patterns, and generate recommendations, freeing up the specialist to focus on complex situations and human interaction.

title: 下水道管路施設の点検・調査
outlook_desc: Aging infrastructure requires increased inspection and repair
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves physical inspection of underground infrastructure, which is difficult to fully automate. However, AI could assist with data analysis of inspection results and predictive maintenance scheduling, leading to moderate exposure.

title: オーケストラ奏者（団員）
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to funding and automation. (わずかな減少、資金と自動化のため)
exposure_rationale: While AI can generate music, the nuanced interpretation, real-time collaboration, and physical dexterity required of an orchestra musician are difficult to replicate. The artistic expression and human connection are also key aspects that AI cannot currently provide.

title: ハローワーク職員
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to digitalization (デジタル化で若干減少)
exposure_rationale: Hello Work staff perform primarily knowledge work involving matching job seekers with employers, providing advice on job training, and assisting with employment insurance procedures. While human interaction is important, AI can automate many aspects of job matching, information provision, and administrative tasks, significantly reshaping the role.

title: 整形外科医
outlook_desc: 高齢化で需要が増加、人手不足 (Aging society drives demand)
exposure_rationale: While AI can assist in diagnosis and surgical planning using imaging and data analysis, the hands-on surgical skills, real-time decision-making during surgery, and patient interaction aspects of an orthopedic surgeon's role limit full automation. The need for nuanced judgment based on individual patient conditions also presents a barrier to complete AI replacement.

title: 衛生管理者
outlook_desc: Aging workforce drives demand; 法令遵守重要
exposure_rationale: While some tasks involve physical inspection and direct interaction with workers, a significant portion of the role involves data analysis (health records), regulatory compliance, and generating reports, which AI can assist with. The need for human empathy and judgment in specific cases limits full automation, but AI can significantly augment the role.

title: 風力発電の企画・調査
outlook_desc: Renewable energy investment drives strong demand (需要増)
exposure_rationale: This role involves significant data analysis (wind data, environmental impact), project planning, and communication, all of which can be augmented or partially automated by AI. While some aspects like site visits and community engagement require a human presence, the core planning and analytical components are highly susceptible to AI influence.

title: 税関職員
outlook_desc: Slight growth due to border security needs. (保安需要でわずかに増加)
exposure_rationale: While some aspects like document review and data analysis related to import/export can be aided by AI, the physical inspection of goods, real-time judgment calls regarding suspicious behavior, and interaction with travelers require human presence and discernment. Therefore, the exposure is moderate, not high.

title: 自動車検査員
outlook_desc: Slight decline due to automation/AI (自動化のため、わずかに減少)
exposure_rationale: Automobile inspectors require a mix of physical inspection and knowledge of regulations. While AI could assist with identifying potential issues and comparing data to standards, the final judgment and physical assessment of the vehicle's condition still require human expertise and presence, especially in nuanced cases.

title: 障害福祉サービス管理責任者
outlook_desc: Significant growth due to aging population (大きな需要増)
exposure_rationale: This role involves significant human interaction, assessment of individual needs, and care planning, which are difficult for AI to fully replicate. However, AI could assist with administrative tasks, data analysis for service planning, and potentially some aspects of monitoring progress, leading to a moderate exposure score.

title: ブロックチェーン・エンジニア
outlook_desc: 急速な成長：ブロックチェーン技術者に対する強い需要
exposure_rationale: Blockchain engineers primarily work with code and algorithms, areas where AI is rapidly advancing. AI can assist with code generation, testing, and optimization, significantly impacting the role. While creativity and problem-solving are still needed, AI tools will likely automate many tasks.

title: 声優
outlook_desc: Stable demand, high competition (競争激しい)
exposure_rationale: While voice acting involves creative expression and nuanced performance, AI is rapidly advancing in voice synthesis and character imitation. AI could potentially assist with tasks like generating initial voice samples or even performing less demanding roles, but the artistic interpretation and emotional depth required for complex characters will likely remain a human domain for the foreseeable future. Japan's cultural emphasis on artistic expression also provides some buffer.

title: 産業医
outlook_desc: Aging workforce drives strong demand (需要増)
exposure_rationale: While AI can assist with analyzing health data and suggesting preventative measures, the role requires significant human interaction, empathy, and nuanced judgment in advising both employers and employees. The legal obligation for a human physician also limits full automation, though AI will likely augment their capabilities.

title: 3Dプリンター技術者
outlook_desc: Growing demand due to manufacturing innovation (製造革新による需要増)
exposure_rationale: 3D printer technicians work with digital designs and software to operate the printers. While some physical manipulation is involved (loading materials, maintenance), the core task relies heavily on digital data and AI could optimize printing parameters, detect errors, and even design parts automatically, significantly reshaping the role.
